title: SIGHT: Reinforcement Learning with Self-Evidence and Information-Gain Diverse Branching for Search Agent
authors: Wenlin Zhong; Jinluan Yang; Yiquan Wu; Yi Liu; Jianhang Yao; Kun Kuang
why_relevant: SIGHT explicitly addresses noisy retrieval in multi-turn search agents, proposing information-gain-driven branching and self-evidence distillation to mitigate 'Tunnel Vision' from low SNR retrievals.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on RL search agent exploration rather than core RAG robustness; relevance is tangential to noise handling.
